title: Bioinformatics analysis identifies biomarkers associated with T-cell depletion in systemic lupus erythematosus.
authors: Yang, Lanqing; Gao, Wei; Yang, Lulu; Liu, Xingyu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学与机器学习识别SLE中T细胞耗竭相关生物标志物，仅涉及转录因子调控网络和分子对接，非核心蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic autoimmune disease that affects multiple organ systems. In SLE, T-cell subsets are closely associated with autoimmunity and organ inflammation. Detecting T-cell exhaustion (TEX)-related biomarkers is crucial for early SLE diagnosis and offers new insights into disease mechanisms. Transcriptomic data for SLE were collected from public databases, and TEX-related genes were obtained from the literature. Biomarkers were identified using analyses such as differential expression analysis and machine learning algorithms. The potential mechanisms of action of these biomarkers were further investigated, including nomogram construction, gene set enrichment analysis, immune microenvironment analysis, molecular regulatory network analysis, molecular docking, and reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction validation. IFIT3, IFIH1, CXCL10, and STAT2 were identified as biomarkers. The nomogram demonstrated good predictive performance. These biomarkers were mainly involved in biological processes such as ribosome biogenesis and negative regulation of viral genome replication. Four significantly different immune cell types were identified, including monocytes and resting memory CD4 T cells. The biomarkers were found to be regulated by several transcription factors and microRNAs. Furthermore, the 4 biomarkers exhibited high binding affinity for several drugs; in particular, the binding energy of STAT2 with bisphenol A was -7.0 kcal/mol. Finally, reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction results showed that all 4 biomarkers were significantly upregulated in SLE patients. In summary, this study identified TEX-related biomarkers in SLE, which may have important clinical implications for the diagnosis and treatment of SLE.
abstract_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种影响多个器官系统的慢性自身免疫性疾病。在SLE中，T细胞亚群与自身免疫及器官炎症密切相关。检测T细胞耗竭（TEX）相关生物标志物对于SLE的早期诊断至关重要，并为疾病机制提供了新的见解。从公共数据库收集SLE的转录组数据，并从文献中获取TEX相关基因。通过差异表达分析和机器学习算法等分析手段鉴定生物标志物。进一步研究了这些生物标志物的潜在作用机制，包括列线图构建、基因集富集分析、免疫微环境分析、分子调控网络分析、分子对接及逆转录定量聚合酶链反应验证。IFIT3、IFIH1、CXCL10和STAT2被鉴定为生物标志物。列线图显示出良好的预测性能。这些生物标志物主要参与核糖体生物发生和病毒基因组复制负调控等生物过程。鉴定出四种显著差异的免疫细胞类型，包括单核细胞和静息记忆CD4 T细胞。发现这些生物标志物受多种转录因子和microRNA调控。此外，这四种生物标志物对多种药物表现出高结合亲和力；特别是STAT2与双酚A的结合能为-7.0 kcal/mol。最后，逆转录定量聚合酶链反应结果显示，所有四种生物标志物在SLE患者中均显著上调。总之，本研究鉴定了SLE中的TEX相关生物标志物，这可能对SLE的诊断和治疗具有重要的临床意义。
